data.name: Alwina
data.gender_notes: Alwina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alwina is derived from the Arabic word 'Al-Wadud', which means 'the loving one'. This name is unisex and is found in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes kindness, devotion, and a deep spiritual connection. The name Alwina carries the meaning “Kind, Devoted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Alwina usually hope their child will grow to embody kind, devoted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alwina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind, Devoted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alwina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
